title: Pressing "Run Project", opening godot, and opening a project in the editor causes a crash most of the time
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in : 4.0.stable and later.
- Not Reproducible in: 3.6.stable and earlier.

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics (12 Threads)

### Issue description

When i try to simply open godot, open a project in the editor, or run a project it results in a crash most of the time.

It is very inconsistent with whether it will run or not. I would say it is about a 60% chance for a crash to occur.

I haven't noticed any type of pattern with whether it works or crashes so it seems like it's just random.

The only error message i have seen is this one that appears when i run the Godot_<version>_win64_console.exe file :
```
================================================================
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.3.stable.official (77dcf97d82cbfe4e4615475fa52ca03da645dbd8)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[2] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[3] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[4] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[5] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[6] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
================================================================
```

### Steps to reproduce

1: Download Godot v4.0.stable or later
2: Open Godot v4.0.stable or later

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
